pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Changes the behaviour of mobs within $(thing)3 blocks$(): they protect you for $(thing)60 seconds$().$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() Path level 3.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: Affected mobs side with you and attack creatures that hurt you. Bosses are immune. The ability consumes hunger and has a cooldown; its radius and duration can be configured.
